# doxygen-awesome-css

Theme of the generated source browser (`build/docs/internals`, `make docs`, see `Doxyfile`), vendored unmodified.

- Source: https://github.com/jothepro/doxygen-awesome-css, tag `v2.5.0`, MIT (see `LICENSE`).
- Files: `doxygen-awesome.css`, `doxygen-awesome-sidebar-only.css`,
  `doxygen-awesome-sidebar-only-darkmode-toggle.css`, `doxygen-awesome-darkmode-toggle.js`,
  `doxygen-awesome-fragment-copy-button.js`, `doxygen-awesome-paragraph-link.js`, `LICENSE`.
- Each file was downloaded from `https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jothepro/doxygen-awesome-css/v2.5.0/<file>`.
- To upgrade: download the same files from the new tag, change the version here and in
  `NOTICE.md`, and check that `docs/doxygen/header.html` still matches the stock header of
  `doxygen -w html` plus the script includes.
